# PDF Redact

> On-device PDF and photo redaction app for iPhone, iPad and Mac (App Store name: "Redact Document & PDF"). Finds personal information automatically, removes it from the file rather than covering it, and audits the export. Nothing is uploaded.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761928221
- Overview: https://coderalert0.github.io/redact-pdf-site/app/
- Support and privacy policy: https://coderalert0.github.io/redact-pdf-site/

## Facts
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad (iOS/iPadOS 17+), Mac (macOS 13+). One purchase covers all three.
- Detects: names, addresses, Social Security numbers, account/routing/card numbers, phone numbers, emails, dates of birth, transaction tables.
- Presets: Standard PII, Financial Statement, Tax Documents, Medical / HIPAA, HIPAA Safe Harbor, Legal / Court.
- Court-filing format: keeps last four digits and birth year (Fed. R. Civ. P. 5.2, Fed. R. Bankr. P. 9037).
- Export: pages rebuilt from visible content; redacted text removed; unredacted text stays searchable (PDF/A); metadata, annotations and bookmarks stripped; optional password.
- Privacy audit on every export (leftover text, missed copies, metadata, annotations, bookmarks).
- Pricing: first export free; then subscription (US $12.99/month with 7-day trial, or $39.99/year) or $4.99 one-time pack of 5 exports.

Step-by-step on iPhone, iPad or Mac.

- [How to redact a pay stub](https://coderalert0.github.io/redact-pdf-site/guides/redact-pay-stub/): Redact a pay stub so it still proves your income: hide your SSN, employee ID and direct-deposit account, keep employer, pay period and pay amounts.

Built-in court-filing format.

On-device text recognition finds names and numbers in images, then the export removes them.
